journey.title: Reconstruct an action after the fact
journey.purpose: The audit journey. Somebody asks what happened, and the answer must name the authorising human, the persona, and the run — including for actions that were refused.

steps.intent: See every action in one place, refusals included.
Narrow to one persona or one time window without losing the count of what was excluded.
Confirm the identity the action was taken as, and the basis it was authorised under.
steps.via: Follow the persona reference from a journal row.

steps.intent: Take the record off the machine so it can be used as evidence elsewhere.
